descriptions.notStarted: The first mission as a member of the Sand Bandits is to steal an order of silk that the queen ordered. Disguised as #p2101004#, I have to go to #b#m260010600##k and get the order of silk from #b#p2101013##k.
descriptions.inProgress: #p2101013# keeps giving me a suspicious look. Arrrghhh... I better talk well and just get the #bsilk#k.
descriptions.completed: I finally got the silk from #p2101013#. Phew... it really is hard to pretend like someone else... anyway, since I succeeded, I better return to #p2101010#!
